api_version: Public dataset-catalogue v1 endpoint; hourly department/decade CSV.GZ resource version and specific wind column not pinned

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no automatic source request or caller-selected path, unbounded domain, secrets, crawler, bulk extraction or retries. Metadata path(s) are only candidate exact origins; actual provider GET requires independently reviewed provider machine-use terms, exact URL, byte cap, body hash and source-specific approved workflow.

response_contract.format: Public dataset metadata: license, publisher, resource IDs and update timestamps. No station observations, field dictionary source bytes or hourly CSV included.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Dataset represents climatologically controlled hourly stations by French department and period. Mainland UTC vs overseas FU must be distinguished; hourly gust (not mean wind), QC flags, instrument height, units, temporal support and duplicate station lineage require exact original CSV and dictionary. Neither annual storm frequency nor insurer vulnerability, TIV or losses derived.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Service request rate and ToS are not independently reviewed; no scheduled dataset downloads, retries or crawler, only future fixed one-resource metadata preflight after rights/transport approval.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Catalogue may include 1,000+ changing official resource entries; pin one exact department, period, last_modified and file SHA before any comparison.

rights_and_policy.notes: Publisher catalog states Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0. That is evidence for this named dataset at catalog level, not independently for each external CSV resource, automated server cadence, hazard/model suitability or derivatives of station measurements. Attribution, resource version and original quality dictionary remain mandatory.

notes: One public dataset JSON endpoint was accessed using an external web read on 2026-11-14, NOT through a trusted source-native GitHub runner; neither binary resource nor exact API response SHA is verified. This contract itself authorizes no HTTP requests.
